en.md: ## 2.0 The disruption ladder

published.md: ## 2.0 中斷階梯

en.md: This chapter defines three disruption levels: **50% Degradation** (降載), **Global Cutoff**, and **Island Partition**. The three levels form an escalation ladder: each level includes every effect of the level below it.

published.md: 本章定義三個中斷梯級：**50% 降載**、**全球斷線**與**島內分割**。這三個梯級構成升級階梯：每個梯級都包含其下方梯級的所有影響。

en.md: Under 50% Degradation, the island loses approximately 50% of its foreign-routed bandwidth, the bandwidth that connects it to the global internet. Global Cutoff takes the conditions of 50% Degradation and removes the remaining foreign-routed bandwidth. Island Partition adds the loss of north–south connectivity inside Taiwan to that total global loss. The domestic network therefore operates normally at the first two levels, and Island Partition is the only level at which traffic between Taiwanese cities fails.

published.md: 在 50% 降載下，全島會失去大約 50% 的對外路由頻寬（即連接全球網際網路的頻寬）。全球斷線則是在 50% 降載的基礎上，將剩餘的對外路由頻寬完全切斷。島內分割則是在全球完全斷線之餘，再加上台灣內部南北連線的中斷。因此，國內網路在前兩個梯級均運作正常，島內分割是唯一會導致台灣各城市間流量失效的梯級。

en.md: The report anchors its analysis on 50% Degradation. Every trace of a shared dependency in Chapter 3 begins at that level and moves up through Global Cutoff to Island Partition.

published.md: 本報告的分析以 50% 降載為基準。第 3 章中對共同依賴的每一處檢視，均從該梯級出發，並向上延伸至全球斷線與島內分割。

en.md: The table below shows the expected signal at each level on four observable measures: each column is one level, and each row is one measure. Some cells name a simulated scenario, a narrowed variant of one level, and the list at the end of this section names all ten. The evidence behind each cell is in §§2.1–2.3, under Recognition signatures.

published.md: 下表顯示四項可觀察指標在各梯級預期的訊號：每一欄代表一個梯級，每一列代表一項指標。部分儲存格標示了模擬情境（即單一梯級的縮小範圍變體），本節末尾的名冊則列出了全部十個模擬情境。每個儲存格背後的證據見 §§2.1–2.3 的「辨識特徵」次小節。

en.md: The table uses routing terms from the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), the protocol that networks use to advertise routes to each other. A network cancels a route by sending a BGP WITHDRAW message. Each network is an autonomous system (AS), and the AS path of a route lists the networks that the route crosses. The control plane is the exchange of these routing messages, and the data plane is the forwarding of user traffic.

published.md: 本表採用邊界閘道協定（BGP）的路由術語，BGP 是各網路用來互相宣告路由的協定。網路會透過發送 BGP WITHDRAW 訊息來撤回路由。每個網路都是一個自治系統（AS），而路由的 AS 路徑則列出該路由所經過的網路。控制平面負責交換這些路由訊息，資料平面則負責轉送使用者流量。

en.md:
| | 50% Degradation | Global Cutoff | Island Partition |
|---|---|---|---|
| BGP behavior | During the sustained plateau (the period in which capacity stays low), routers send no WITHDRAW messages: the control plane stays silent while the data plane degrades. At onset, Multi-Cable Loss adds a short spike of WITHDRAW messages before routes reconverge (settle) onto the surviving paths. | Three patterns lead to the same data-plane outcome. First, physical cable loss produces a cliff of WITHDRAW messages (a sudden mass withdrawal of routes). Second, under administrative allowlisting (passing only approved traffic), as in Iran in 2026, most IPv4 routes stay advertised but traffic falls to zero. In that case, nearly all IPv6 routes were withdrawn hours before the traffic stopped (§2.2). Third, in a forwarding failure inside a carrier, as at Rogers in 2022, routes stay advertised but traffic falls to zero. | Routes inside each half of the island stay stable, while prefixes (blocks of addresses) in the other half are withdrawn or unreachable. AS paths shift toward a new upstream AS. |
| Traffic plane | Traffic is degraded but survives: round-trip time (RTT) is higher and packet loss is sustained, with no cliff (no sudden drop). The domestic network is intact. | A cliff: international traffic drops to near zero within minutes of onset, while domestic traffic is intact. | Traffic is normal inside each half, and zero between the halves and to the rest of the world. |
| DNS/cache behavior | The rate of SERVFAIL responses rises gradually as resolver RTT exceeds client timeouts. SERVFAIL is the code that a Domain Name System (DNS) resolver returns when it cannot complete a lookup. The cache hit rate may rise, and there is no immediate cliff. | When the cutoff is triggered through BGP, lookups for domains whose authoritative servers are outside Taiwan return SERVFAIL at once. Cached responses then expire in staggered waves, each when its time-to-live (TTL) runs out. Measured from one network in Taiwan in November 2026, address records of names served through content delivery networks (CDNs) expire after about one to five minutes (Appendix A, F7). Of all sampled names, 86.6% expire within an hour. Mail-exchanger (MX) and name-server (NS) records were not measured; the report estimates that they last up to 7 days. Resolvers that serve stale records stretch each expiry by up to a few days. §2.2 gives the basis. | Lookups succeed inside each half and fail between the halves. The cache gives a grace period, which shrinks until the TTLs expire. |
| Recovery path | The queue for cable repair ships and the engineering schedule govern recovery, which takes weeks to months per cable segment. | Recovery depends on the cause. For physical loss (All-Cable Loss), the queue for repair ships governs recovery, at weeks per segment. For an administrative order with cables intact (Administrative Cutoff), only a political reversal ends the cutoff, and no engineering schedule applies. Documented cases of this kind range from a near-total cutoff of about five days, with about a week to broad restoration ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/); §2.2 compares the sources), to one that April 2026 reporting described as still ongoing and record-breaking ([Al Jazeera, April 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/5/frustration-grows-as-irans-wartime-internet-shutdown-breaks-grim-record/)). §2.2 follows the later case further. | Recovery has two tracks: global restoration and repair of the domestic trunks. Where part of the cutoff is administrative, cable repair does not shorten that part. |

en.md: **How to read §§2.1–2.3.** Each of the three sections has six subsections, in this order. **Definition** defines the level and states what it inherits from the level below. **What the failure looks like** describes what an engineer observes. At the three levels in turn, the engineer observes a brownout (slow, lossy service), a hard edge (international traffic stops outright), and a split between north and south. **Course over time** follows the disruption through numbered Phases, from onset to the slow final recovery.

published.md: **§§2.1–2.3 閱讀說明。**這三個小節各自包含六個次小節，順序如下。**定義**為該梯級下定義，並說明其承襲了下方梯級的哪些影響。**失效樣貌**描述工程師觀察到的現象。工程師在三個梯級會依次觀察到降質（慢速且高遺失率的服務）、硬性斷崖（國際流量完全中斷），以及南北分割。**時間歷程**則追蹤中斷過程在各個具編號階段中的變化，從發作一直到漫長的最終復原。

en.md: **Recognition signatures** is the chapter's main diagnostic content: it gives the telemetry (what the measurements show) for each row of the table above. The subsection also shows how to tell the level from the neighboring levels. Where one level has forms that fail by different mechanisms, it shows how to tell those forms apart.

published.md: **辨識特徵**是本章主要的診斷內容：它提供了上表每一列的遙測資料（即各項測量值所顯示的結果）。該次小節也說明如何將該梯級與相鄰梯級區分開來。若某一梯級包含透過不同機制失效的型態，該次小節也會說明如何區分這些型態。

en.md: **Simulated scenarios** gives each simulated scenario a block with four parts. The parts are what happens, the precedent, how to tell the simulated scenario from a named one at the same level, and a note for drills. **In Chapter 3** names, in one sentence, where Chapter 3 traces the shared dependencies of the level.

published.md: **模擬情境**為每個模擬情境提供一個包含四個部分的區塊。這四個部分分別是：事件經過、前例、如何與同一梯級中的特定情境區分，以及演練備註。**第 3 章對應內容**則用一句話指出第 3 章在哪裡追蹤該梯級的共同依賴。

en.md: Each block also grades how far its precedent applies to Taiwan. The grade follows the label **Applies to Taiwan:** in the precedent part of the block. The grade *directly* means that the same event could happen in Taiwan. The grade *partly* means that the mechanism applies, but the scale or the conditions differ. The grade *in mechanism only* means that no comparable event exists, so only the mechanism applies.

en.md: ## 2.3 Island Partition

published.md: ## 2.3 Island Partition

en.md: ### Definition

published.md: ### 定義（Definition）

en.md: Island Partition is the worst case on the escalation ladder, because two failures happen together. The north–south domestic long-haul trunks (the main long-distance links inside Taiwan) are cut, so northern Taiwan cannot reach southern Taiwan. At the same time, all global connectivity is lost.

published.md: 在升級階梯上，「島內分割」屬於最嚴重的狀況，因為有兩項失效同時發生。南北向的國內長途幹線（即台灣內部的主要長途鏈路）中斷，導致台灣北部無法連通台灣南部；與此同時，對外的全球連線能力也完全喪失。

en.md: Island Partition inherits every effect of Global Cutoff in full. International traffic stops completely, and cache entries of the Domain Name System (DNS) for non-.tw names expire with no way to refresh them. Time-limited protocol data expires as well, and connections fail completely instead of slowing down.

published.md: 島內分割完全繼承全球斷線的所有影響。國際流量徹底中斷，網域名稱系統（DNS）中非 .tw 網名的快取紀錄陸續過期且無法更新。具時效性的協定資料同樣會過期，連線也不再只是變慢，而是直接徹底失敗。

en.md: The domestic split is added to this global loss. The brownout effects of 50% Degradation (slow, lossy service) are included and exceeded. Each half of the island, north or south, therefore becomes a working network that can reach no other network, domestic or international.

published.md: 除了全球連線喪失之外，還疊加了國內網路分割。50% 降載的降質影響（服務變慢且封包遺失）已被包含且進一步惡化。因此，本島不論是北半部或南半部，都會變成一個自身可正常運作，卻無法連通任何其他國內或國際網路的獨立網路。

en.md: The definition requires both conditions in full: no global access and no north–south link. A partition in which some global access survives falls outside the definition, and the report analyzes that case only as the simulated scenario Partial-Access Partition.

published.md: 此定義要求兩項條件同時完全成立：無全球連網能力，且無南北向連結。若分割發生時仍有部分全球連網能力倖存，即不符合本項定義；本報告僅將該狀況作為「部分連外分割」模擬情境進行分析。

en.md: ### What the failure looks like

published.md: ### 失效樣貌（What the failure looks like）

en.md: The domestic network inside each half works as it did before the event. Latency and packet loss are normal, and services hosted in that half are fully reachable. Across the boundary between the halves, the network fails completely: the failure is complete unreachability, not degradation.

published.md: 各半部內部的國內網路仍維持事件發生前的運作狀態。延遲與封包遺失率皆屬正常，且託管於該半部的服務完全可連通。然而，一旦跨越南北半部的邊界，網路便完全失效：這種失效是徹底無法連通，而非僅是降級。

en.md: A service in the other half is unreachable by the same mechanism as any foreign-hosted service under Global Cutoff. The connection request (the TCP SYN) gets no reply, and the attempt ends only when the operating system times out. The attempt neither fails quickly nor completes slowly.

published.md: 欲存取位於另一半部的服務，其無法連通的機制與全球斷線下存取境外託管服務相同。連線請求（TCP SYN 封包）收不到任何回應，直到作業系統連線逾時嘗試才會結束。這種嘗試既不會快速失敗，也不會緩慢完成。

en.md: The failure across the boundary separates Island Partition from the two lower levels. Under 50% Degradation and under Global Cutoff, the domestic network is intact, so traffic between north and south flows normally. Under Island Partition, domestic traffic between the halves is as unreachable as international traffic.

published.md: 跨界線的失效，將島內分割與前兩個較低梯級區隔開來。在 50% 降載與全球斷線下，國內網路維持完整，南北之間的流量也能正常流通。但在島內分割下，兩半部之間的國內流量就像國際流量一樣無法連通。

en.md: The closest available real case is below national scale: the routing of occupied Kherson, Ukraine, in 2022–2024 (§2.1, Compromised Transit). In May 2022, Russian forces coerced KhersonTelecom (AS47598) onto upstream providers in Crimea (the networks that carry another network's traffic onward). Kentik then found, in data from route collectors (servers that record the routes that networks announce), that the city was isolated from Ukrainian networks ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)). RIPE Labs measured the matching reversal in latency direction ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

published.md: 最接近的真實案例發生於國家層級以下：2022 至 2024 年烏克蘭赫爾松被佔領區的路由狀況（§2.1，轉接遭挾持）。2022 年 5 月，俄羅斯軍隊脅迫 KhersonTelecom（AS47598）改經克里米亞的上游業者（即負責將其他網路流量向外轉送的網路）。Kentik 隨後從路由收集器（記錄各網路宣告路由的伺服器）的資料中發現，該城市已與烏克蘭網路隔離（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。RIPE Labs 也測量到對應的延遲方向翻轉（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: The Kherson case is similar in structure but is not a direct precedent. The case happened below national scale, and the unoccupied parts of Ukraine kept their global connectivity. No comparable real event documents what Island Partition requires: a partition at island scale combined with a global cutoff at the same time.

published.md: 赫爾松案例在結構上類似，但並非直接前例。該事件發生於國家層級以下，且烏克蘭未被佔領的區域仍保有全球連網能力。目前尚無可比擬的真實事件能佐證「島內分割」所要求的條件：全島層級的分割同時伴隨全球斷線。

en.md: ### Course over time

published.md: ### 時間歷程（Course over time）

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* The partition appears in routing within minutes of the trunk cuts. Networks announce their routes to each other through the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP). In those minutes, the routes between the two halves (BGP prefixes) are withdrawn or silently dropped (black-holed).

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 在幹線切斷後的數分鐘內，路由層面就會顯現分割。各網路透過邊界閘道協定（BGP）互相宣告路由。在這幾分鐘內，兩半部之間的路由（BGP 前綴）會被撤回或靜默丟棄（黑洞化）。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* For planning, this report assumes that a partition of Taiwan would take days to settle, a scale comparable to Kherson. Kherson had a city-wide outage on April 30, 2022. On May 1, the first network returned through the Crimean provider. After a further outage on May 30, Kherson's internet service providers (ISPs) lost their links to other Ukrainian networks, "possibly for good". Within a few days, every network in the city was either offline or connected through the Crimean provider ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)).

published.md: *（依據烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析所做的推論，RIPE Labs 與 Kentik，2022–2024 年；未經獨立證實）* 在規劃上，本報告假設台灣若發生分割，需要數天的時間才會穩定下來，其時間跨度與赫爾松相當。赫爾松於 2022 年 4 月 30 日發生全城網路中斷；5 月 1 日，首個網路透過克里米亞業者恢復連線；在 5 月 30 日經歷另一次中斷後，赫爾松的網際網路服務業者（ISP）失去了與其他烏克蘭網路的連結，「可能永久切斷」。幾天之內，城內的每個網路要麼離線，要麼透過克里米亞業者連線（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* In the first Phase, from hours to days after onset, the processes of Global Cutoff run in both halves at once. Applications whose servers are in the other half time out as they do under Global Cutoff. DNS cache entries for names in the other half or abroad expire as their time-to-live periods (TTLs) end, with no way to refresh them.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」與「全球斷線」定義所做的結構性推論）* 在第一階段，即事件發生後的數小時至數天內，全球斷線的演變過程會在南北兩半部同時展開。伺服器位於另一半部的應用程式會像在全球斷線下一樣發生逾時。位於另一半部或國外網名的 DNS 快取紀錄，隨著存活時間（TTL）到期而失效，且無法更新。

en.md: *(Inference from the USENIX OSDI 2018 study of 136 partition failures; not independently confirmed for any named product)* A data store that documents how it behaves in a partition can still fail worse than documented. That study examined 136 network-partitioning failures in 25 widely used distributed systems ([Alquraan et al., USENIX OSDI, 2018](https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi18/presentation/alquraan)). Most of them led to catastrophic effects such as data loss, reappearance of deleted data, broken locks and system crashes. The documented partition behaviour of a store is therefore its best case under Island Partition, not its expected case.

published.md: *（依據 USENIX OSDI 2018 針對 136 起分割失效案例的研究所做的推論；未針對任何具名產品獨立證實）* 即使資料存放區在文件中說明了網路分割時的行為，實際發生時仍可能出現比文件記載更嚴重的失效。該研究檢視了 25 套廣泛使用的分散式系統中發生的 136 起網路分割失效案例（[Alquraan et al., USENIX OSDI, 2018](https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi18/presentation/alquraan)），其中多數都導致災難性後果，例如資料遺失、已刪除資料重現、鎖定失效與系統當機。因此，資料存放區在文件中記載的分割行為，只是它在島內分割下的最佳情況，而非預期情況。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* The protocol clocks (time limits built into protocols) were already counting down: TLS certificate renewal windows, OCSP stapling refresh, and DNSSEC RRSIG validity periods. In this first Phase, these clocks approach the delayed failures described under Protocol-Clock Cascade.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」與「全球斷線」定義所做的結構性推論）* 協定時鐘（即協定內建的時間限制）原本就在倒數：TLS 憑證更新視窗、OCSP 裝訂重新整理，以及 DNSSEC RRSIG 的有效期限。在此第一階段中，這些時鐘會逐漸逼近「協定時鐘連鎖失效」中所描述的延遲失效。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* In a second Phase, a partition maintained by forced rerouting stays exposed to further disruption along the coerced upstream route. Forced rerouting means that an outside party coerces a network onto an upstream provider that the outside party chooses. Kherson's traffic was forced through Crimea in this way. In October 2022, damage to the Kerch Strait Bridge cable then raised latency to networks that depend on UMLC by 5–10 ms, as RIPE Labs documented ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

published.md: *（依據烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析所做的推論，RIPE Labs 與 Kentik，2022–2024 年；未經獨立證實）* 在第二階段，藉由強制重導路由所維持的分割，會持續面臨受脅迫上游路徑上的進一步中斷風險。強制重導路由意指外部勢力強迫某網路改用其指定的上游業者；赫爾松的流量便是以此方式被強迫行經克里米亞。如 RIPE Labs 所記載，2022 年 10 月刻赤海峽大橋海纜受損，導致依賴 UMLC 的網路延遲增加 5–10 毫秒（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: ### Recognition signatures

published.md: ### 辨識特徵（Recognition signatures）

en.md: **BGP and routing plane.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* At onset, routes between the halves are withdrawn or black-holed, while routes within each half stay announced and stable. A BGP monitor or route collector inside either half therefore records no withdrawal for the prefixes of its own half. For the prefixes of the other half it records withdrawals, or no event at all where the routes are black-holed. External route collectors see the networks of each half (autonomous systems, identified by AS numbers or ASNs) become unreachable from the other half. This change shows in AS-path data, which lists the networks that each route crosses.

published.md: **BGP 與路由平面。** *（依據「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 在事件發生時，兩半部之間的路由會被撤回或遭黑洞化，而各半部內部的路由則維持宣告且保持穩定。因此，位於任一半部內部的 BGP 監測器或路由收集器，不會記錄到該半部自身前綴的撤回事件；至於另一半部的前綴，則會記錄到路由撤回，或是在路由遭黑洞化時完全記錄不到任何事件。外部路由收集器會觀察到，各半部的網路（即以 AS 編號或 ASN 識別的自治系統）變得無法從另一半部連通。這項變化會呈現在 AS 路徑資料中，該資料列出了每條路由所經過的網路。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition and the Kentik Kherson routing documentation cited above)* A partition produced by forced rerouting, not by route withdrawal, changes the AS path detectably. Within days of onset, prefixes from one half are announced through a new upstream AS, as at Kherson (§2.1, Compromised Transit; [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)). Such a partition therefore has its own routing signature: no withdrawals between the halves, together with a new upstream AS path for one half. Physical connectivity survives but passes through an adversary's upstream, whereas in a partition produced by route withdrawal the paths between the halves disappear from the routing table.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」定義與上述 Kentik 對赫爾松路由文件的結構性推論）* 由強制重導路由而非路由撤回所造成的分割，會明顯改變 AS 路徑。在事件發生後的數天內，來自其中一半部的前綴會透過新的上游 AS 進行宣告，正如赫爾松的情況（§2.1，轉接遭挾持；[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。因此，此類分割具有專屬的路由特徵：兩半部之間沒有撤回事件，同時其中一半部出現新的上游 AS 路徑。實體連線能力依然存在，但會行經敵對方的上游；相對地，在路由撤回造成的分割中，兩半部之間的路徑會直接從路由表中消失。

en.md: **Traffic plane.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* Within each half, traffic volume and loss rate stay at their pre-event levels. Traffic between the halves is zero, not lossy, and it fails by timeout, as international traffic does under Global Cutoff. RIPE Atlas probes are small measurement devices hosted on volunteers' networks. A probe in the northern half reaches northern services at normal latency and times out on every southern and international destination. A probe in the southern half shows the mirror image.

published.md: **流量平面。** *（依據「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 在各半部內部，流量與封包遺失率皆維持在事件發生前的水準。兩半部之間的流量為零（而非僅是品質下降），且像在全球斷線下的國際流量一樣因逾時而失敗。RIPE Atlas 探針是部署在志願者網路上的小型測量設備；位於北半部的探針能以正常延遲連通北部服務，但在嘗試連通所有南部與國際目的地時皆會逾時。位於南半部的探針則呈現完全相反的鏡像狀況。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* This two-way split, with normal traffic inside each half, is the definitive sign in the measurements that separates Island Partition from Global Cutoff. Under Global Cutoff, probes anywhere on the island see zero outbound connectivity, while domestic traffic flows across the whole island.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 這種雙向分割且各半部內部流量正常的特徵，是測量數據中將「島內分割」與「全球斷線」區分開來的關鍵指標。在全球斷線下，全島各地的探針都會觀察到對外連線能力歸零，但國內流量仍能在全島暢通。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* Aggregate traffic on Cloudflare Radar (Cloudflare's public traffic dashboard) cannot separate the two levels. Both levels remove all global access, so the international aggregate falls to near zero under each. City-level data does not separate them either: under both levels a city shows domestic traffic alongside zero international traffic. The real difference lies in where domestic traffic can go. Under Global Cutoff, a user in the north still reaches a service hosted in the south. Under Island Partition, domestic traffic survives only inside each half. Separating the two levels therefore requires a measurement that crosses the boundary, such as a probe in one half that tests a target in the other half.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」與「全球斷線」定義所做的結構性推論）* Cloudflare Radar（Cloudflare 的公開流量儀表板）上的整體流量無法區分這兩個梯級。這兩個梯級都會切斷所有全球連網能力，因此兩者的國際整體流量都會降至接近零。城市層級資料同樣無法區分兩者：在這兩個梯級下，單一城市都會顯示仍有國內流量，但國際流量歸零。真正的差異在於國內流量能通往何處。在全球斷線下，位於北部的使用者仍可連上託管於南部的服務；在島內分割下，國內流量則僅能在各半部內部維持連通。因此，要區分這兩個梯級，必須仰賴跨界線的量測，例如由其中一半部的探針測試位於另一半部的目標。

en.md: **DNS and cache behavior.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* Within each half, names hosted abroad or in the other half resolve as they do under Global Cutoff. Cache entries expire as their TTLs end, with no way to refresh them. A resolver returns SERVFAIL (the response code for a lookup that it cannot complete) for any name whose authoritative server is off the island or in the other half. An authoritative server holds the official records of a name.

published.md: **DNS 與快取行為。** *（依據「島內分割」與「全球斷線」定義所做的結構性推論）* 在各半部內部，託管於國外或另一半部的網名，解析方式與全球斷線下相同。快取紀錄隨著 TTL 到期而失效，且無法更新。對於權威伺服器位於島外或另一半部的任何網名，解析器都會傳回 SERVFAIL（無法完成查詢時的回應碼）。權威伺服器保存著該網名的官方紀錄。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* A .tw zone whose primary authoritative nameservers are in the other half depends on secondary nameservers in the user's own half. These secondary nameservers are the only mechanism that prevents split-brain SERVFAIL, a lookup failure caused by the split between the halves. Without them, the connectivity failure becomes a name-resolution failure for users in that half. The name-resolution failure occurs even when the domain's web servers are in that half and operational.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 若某個 .tw 區域的主要權威名稱伺服器位於另一半部，則需仰賴位於使用者所在半部的次要名稱伺服器。這些次要名稱伺服器是防止發生「腦裂 SERVFAIL」（即由南北半部分割所導致的查詢失敗）的唯一機制。若缺乏次要名稱伺服器，對該半部的使用者而言，連線失效就會演變成網名解析失敗；即使該網域的 Web 伺服器就位於該半部且正常運作，網名解析失敗依然會發生。

en.md: **Recovery path.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* Recovery requires two failures to be resolved independently. The cut trunks follow the timeline of a physical engineering repair. The loss of global connectivity follows the timeline of a cable repair or of an administrative reversal. Neither repair resolves the other, so restoration takes at least as long as the longer timeline. The two independent repairs give Island Partition the compound worst-case recovery on the escalation ladder.

published.md: **復原路徑。** *（依據「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 復原需要各自獨立解決兩項失效。中斷的幹線遵循實體工程搶修的時間表；全球連網能力的喪失則遵循海纜修復或行政決策撤銷的時間表。兩種修復無法互相替代，因此復原至少需要耗費較長時間者的時程。這兩項獨立的修復工作，使島內分割成為升級階梯中最複雜嚴重的復原狀況。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* Where forced rerouting maintains the partition, restoring the pre-partition path requires removing the outside coercion. Removing the coercion is a political or military event, not a cable splice. RIPE Labs reported that latency at Kherson returned to pre-partition levels "pretty quickly" once liberation on November 11, 2022 removed the coercion. This return of latency is consistent with routing going back to its pre-partition paths as soon as the AS-path coercion ended ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

published.md: *（依據烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析所做的推論，RIPE Labs 與 Kentik，2022–2024 年；未經獨立證實）* 在透過強制重導路由來維持分割的情況下，若要恢復分割前的路徑，必須先解除外部脅迫。解除脅迫屬於政治或軍事事件，而非海纜接續工程。RIPE Labs 報導指出，當 2022 年 11 月 11 日收復赫爾松並解除脅迫後，赫爾松的延遲「相當迅速地」恢復到分割前的水準。延遲的回升與 AS 路徑脅迫一結束、路由便立即恢復為分割前路徑的現象相符（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: **Telling the simulated scenarios apart.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Partial-Access Partition definitions)* Partial-Access Partition differs from Island Partition itself in traffic volume and in its geographic distribution. Island Partition itself shows near-zero aggregate traffic from both halves on Cloudflare Radar and in the active probing of IODA (the Internet Outage Detection and Analysis project). Partial-Access Partition shows a drop to a lower level, not a fall to near zero, and residual traffic from one half makes city-level data geographically uneven.

published.md: **區分各模擬情境。** *（依據「島內分割」與「部分連外分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 「部分連外分割」與「島內分割」本身的差異，在於流量大小及其地理分布。島內分割本身在 Cloudflare Radar 以及 IODA（網路中斷偵測與分析計畫）的主動探測中，兩半部的整體流量都會接近零。部分連外分割則顯示流量降至較低水準而非接近零，且來自其中一半部的殘餘流量會使城市層級資料在地理分布上呈現不均勻。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Single-City Isolation definitions)* Single-City Isolation differs in the geographic scope of the traffic failure. Under Island Partition itself, RIPE Atlas probes anywhere in either half reach nothing in the other half and nothing abroad. Single-City Isolation inherits that north–south partition and adds a second, smaller boundary around one city. Probes outside the isolated city show the signature of Island Partition itself and still reach the rest of their own half. A probe inside the city reaches no destination outside the city, not even one in its own half.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」與「單城孤立」定義所做的結構性推論）* 單城孤立的差異在於流量失效的地理範圍。在純粹的島內分割下，位於任一半部任何位置的 RIPE Atlas 探針，都無法連上另一半部或國外的任何目標。單城孤立承襲了這道南北分割，並針對單一城市加上第二道範圍更小的邊界。位於受孤立城市之外的探針，會呈現純粹島內分割的特徵，且仍可連上所屬半部的其餘地區；位於該城市內部的探針，則無法連上城外的任何目的地，就連同一半部內的其他地點也不例外。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Site-Level Blackout definitions)* Site-Level Blackout produces no BGP signal and requires no island-wide routing event. A site with no upstream connectivity takes no part in the routing table. In measurements, the site cannot be told apart from a network segment that is switched off, and the site shows no split in reachability. The site's absence from the responses to active probing is therefore the only sign visible from outside.

published.md: *（依據「島內分割」與「站點全斷」定義所做的結構性推論）* 「站點全斷」不會產生 BGP 訊號，也不需要全島層級的路由事件。缺乏上游連線能力的站點不會參與路由表；在測量中，無法將該站點與關閉的網段區分開來，且該站點不會顯現連通性的分割現象。因此，該站點未回應主動探測，是從外部唯一能觀察到的徵兆。

en.md: ### Simulated scenarios

published.md: ### 模擬情境（Simulated scenarios）

en.md: #### Partial-Access Partition

published.md: #### Partial-Access Partition

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: the north–south domestic trunks are cut and most global connectivity is lost. One half keeps a surviving international cable path, which gives limited global access to that half only. The other half has none.

published.md: 島內分割下的一種模擬情境：南北向國內幹線中斷，且大部分全球連線能力喪失。其中一半部保留了一條倖存的國際海纜路徑，使其獨享有限的全球連網能力，另一半部則完全沒有。

en.md: **What happens.** The two halves fail unevenly. The half with no surviving cable follows Island Partition itself: it reaches neither the other half nor the rest of the world. In the other half, a cable landing station (the site where a submarine cable comes ashore) survives in one geographic cluster, such as the southern cluster at Fangshan (枋山). The surviving station provides a small amount of global bandwidth.

published.md: **事件經過。** 南北兩半部的失效狀況並不對等。完全沒有海纜倖存的一半部遵循島內分割本身：既無法連通另一半部，也無法連通世界其他地方。而在另一半部，某個地理聚落（例如枋山的南部聚落）中有海纜登陸站（即海纜登陸的地點）倖存，該倖存的登陸站提供了少量的全球頻寬。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the k1, k2, and k3 gateway-kind descriptions in §3.2.1 and the Island Partition definition)* Whether that bandwidth is usable depends on the international gateway that serves the surviving cable. The table gives the result for each failure kind of that gateway:

published.md: *（依據 §3.2.1 中 k1、k2、k3 閘道類型的說明與「島內分割」定義所做的結構性推論）* 該頻寬是否可用，取決於服務該倖存海纜的國際閘道。下表列出該閘道在各失效類型下的結果：

en.md:
| Gateway kind (§3.2.1) | Global access of the half that keeps a cable |
|---|---|
| k1, administrative shutdown | None in practice. The gateway blocks all outbound traffic, whatever physical path it arrives on. The physical survival of the cable therefore makes no practical difference |
| k2, throughput ceiling | Like a brownout. An administrative throttle on general civilian traffic leaves the surviving half's international access closer to what 50% Degradation looks like. The other half has no global access |
| k3, forced rerouting | Traffic flows, but it passes through adversary-controlled infrastructure. This exposes the half's international communications to content inspection and forced path selection |

published.md:
| 閘道類型（§3.2.1） | 保有海纜的半部之全球連網能力 |
|---|---|
| k1，行政關閉 | 實質上無。無論流量經由何種實體路徑抵達，閘道都會阻擋所有對外流量。因此海纜的實體倖存並無實質差異 |
| k2，傳輸量上限 | 類似降質。對一般民用流量施加行政限速，使倖存半部的全球存取狀況更接近 50% 降載的情形。另一半部則完全無法連外 |
| k3，強制重導路由 | 流量可通暢流動，但會行經敵對方控制的基礎設施。這使得該半部的國際通訊暴露於內容檢查與強制路徑選擇的風險中 |

en.md: Under every gateway kind, domestic traffic between the halves stays unreachable. The cut north–south trunks are the defining failure of Island Partition, and they carry no traffic whatever the gateway policy.

published.md: 無論何種閘道類型，兩半部之間的國內流量皆持續無法連通。南北向幹線中斷是島內分割的核心特徵失效，無論閘道政策為何，幹線皆無法傳送任何流量。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* The Kherson case documents uneven access below national scale. The city received limited connectivity through Crimea, while unoccupied Ukrainian regions kept their own international paths. Two geographically distinct areas with different upstream providers therefore operated at the same time. Two sources document how the routing paths and the latency direction of the two areas differed: [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) and [RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/).

published.md: **前例。** *（依據烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析所做的推論，RIPE Labs 與 Kentik，2022–2024 年；未經獨立證實）* 赫爾松案例記錄了國家層級以下的非對等連網狀況。該城市透過克里米亞獲得有限的連線能力，而烏克蘭未被佔領的區域則保有自己的國際路徑。因此，兩個使用不同上游業者的地理區域同時運作。有兩份文獻記錄了這兩個區域的路由路徑與延遲方向有何不同：[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) 以及 [RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)。

en.md: *(Inference from research interviews with a member of a community civil-defence group in Taiwan and a participant in civil-defence drills in Taiwan, June 2026; not independently confirmed)* The gateway failure kind (k1, k2, or k3) decides whether a surviving physical cable gives usable global access. The first participant expects that a blackout in Taiwan would come from a government order while the cables still work. The second expects that critical communications would keep reserved bandwidth and that cellular service would not.

published.md: *（依據 2026 年 6 月對一名台灣社區民防團體成員與一名台灣民防演練參與者的研究訪談所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 閘道失效類型（k1、k2 或 k3）決定了倖存的實體海纜能否提供可用的全球連網能力。第一位受訪者預期，台灣若發生斷網，將源於政府下令，而此時海纜本身仍可正常運作；第二位受訪者則預期，關鍵通訊仍會保有預留頻寬，但行動網路服務則不會。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. The Kherson case is a comparable event of uneven access, but the scale differs: Kherson was below national scale, and this scenario covers the whole island. Three of Taiwan's four cable landing points are in the north, at Bali and Tamsui in New Taipei City and at Toucheng in Yilan County, and the fourth is at Fangshan (枋山) in Pingtung County, at the southern end of the island ([Taipei Times, April 16, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2023/04/16/2003798023)).

published.md: **對台灣的適用程度：** 部分適用。赫爾松案例同樣屬於連網能力不均的事件，但兩者規模不同：赫爾松案例的規模低於國家層級，而本情境則涵蓋全島。台灣四個海纜登陸點中有三個位於北部，分別在新北市八里、淡水與宜蘭縣頭城；第四個則位於台灣南端的屏東縣枋山（[Taipei Times, April 16, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2023/04/16/2003798023)）。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the landing-point locations in the Taipei Times report cited above)* The northern points and Fangshan lie at opposite ends of the island, so an event confined to one end can leave the other end's stations standing. The survival of one station cluster without the other is therefore plausible under the physical triggers that produce Island Partition.

published.md: *（依據上述 Taipei Times 報導所載登陸點位置所做的結構性推論）* 北部登陸點與枋山分處台灣南北兩端，局限於其中一端的事件，仍可能讓另一端的登陸站維持運作。因此，在引發島內分割的實體觸發事件下，其中一組登陸站群倖存而另一組中斷，確實可能發生。

en.md: **How to tell it from Single-City Isolation.** *(Structural inference from the Partial-Access Partition and Single-City Isolation definitions)* The difference is geographic scope. Partial-Access Partition cuts the north–south trunks across the whole island and leaves the halves with unequal international access. Single-City Isolation cuts all the upstream links of one municipality, while the domestic network in the rest of each half stays intact.

published.md: **如何與「單城孤立」區分。** *（依據「部分連外分割」與「單城孤立」定義所做的結構性推論）* 兩者的差異在於地理範圍。部分連外分割切斷了全島的南北向幹線，並使南北兩半部擁有不對等的國際連網能力；單城孤立則是切斷單一直轄市／市的所有上游連結，而各半部其餘區域的國內網路仍完好無損。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would change the surviving half's gateway failure kind from run to run (k1 shut down by administrative order, k2 throttled, k3 watched by an adversary, or open) and ask cross-functional teams, with no network information beyond the scenario, which services and communication paths survive under each gateway condition.

published.md: **演練備註。** 針對本情境的桌上推演，可在不同輪次中變更倖存半部的閘道失效類型（行政命令關閉的 k1、受限速的 k2、遭敵對方監控的 k3 或完全開放），並在不提供情境之外的網路資訊下，詢問跨領域團隊在各個閘道條件下，哪些服務與通訊路徑得以倖存。

en.md: #### Single-City Isolation

published.md: #### Single-City Isolation

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: one city (a municipality or urban area) loses all its upstream links to the rest of the island's domestic network at once. The wider island network keeps operating within each half of the partition.

published.md: 島內分割下的一種模擬情境：單一城市（直轄市／市或都會區）同時失去了連接全島其餘國內網路的所有上游連結。較廣泛的全島網路則在分割後的各半部內部維持運作。

en.md: **What happens.** A single physical event cuts every upstream link into the city. The event is a trunk failure along a geographic corridor, or cable damage at a bridge or mountain pass. The event can also be the simultaneous loss of all the last-mile aggregation points that feed the city (the sites where the final links to users join the wider network). Elsewhere in each half, the domestic network keeps operating normally.

published.md: **事件經過。** 單一實體事件切斷了進入該城市的所有上游連結。該事件可能是沿著地理廊道的幹線失效，或者是橋樑或鞍部／隘口處的纜線受損；也可以是服務該城市的所有最後一哩彙集點（即連接使用者的最終鏈路匯入更廣泛網路之設施）同時喪失。在各半部的其他地方，國內網路仍保持正常運作。

en.md: From inside the city, every service hosted outside the city is unreachable, including services on the rest of the island. The north–south partition already divides those services, and the failure of the city's own upstream links now removes them entirely. The unreachable services also include international services, which the concurrent Global Cutoff already removes.

published.md: 從城市內部來看，託管於該城市外部的所有服務皆無法連通，包括全島其餘地方的服務。南北分割原已將這些服務切割，而該城市自身上游連結的失效，如今更將其徹底移除。無法連通的服務亦包含國際服務，但同時發生的全球斷線原本就已將其中斷。

en.md: Services hosted inside the city still serve local users over the city's internal network, so emergency responders in the city can reach only local resources. Coordination systems, databases and communication paths hosted anywhere outside the city are as unreachable as foreign ones.

published.md: 託管於該城市內部的服務仍能透過城市內部網路為在地使用者提供服務，因此城內的應變人員僅能存取在地資源。託管於城市外部任何地方的協調系統、資料庫與通訊路徑，就像國外資源一樣無法連通。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* The Kherson case documents routing isolation at city scale. All of the city's internet access was rerouted through a single non-Ukrainian upstream, and the rerouting made the city a routing zone disconnected from the Ukrainian domestic network. Kentik documents the BGP path change that produced this isolation ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)).

published.md: **前例。** *（依據烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析所做的推論，RIPE Labs 與 Kentik，2022–2024 年；未經獨立證實）* 赫爾松案例記錄了城市規模的路由孤立。該城市所有的網際網路存取皆被重導流經單一非烏克蘭上游，這次重導流使該城市成為與烏克蘭國內網路斷開連結的路由區域。Kentik 記錄了造成此孤立狀態的 BGP 路徑變更（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。

en.md: The lead developer of dComms said that shelling in Ukraine regularly cut the fiber optic cables leading out of a city, and that connections returned within hours or days (Research interview with the lead developer of dComms, a civilian-communications project deployed in wartime Ukraine, June 2026). *(Inference from research interviews with the lead developer of dComms and a participant in civil-defence drills in Taiwan, June 2026; not independently confirmed)* The report takes Single-City Isolation as a scenario for drills on that account. The drills are for civil-society and private-sector engineers who reason about how local services survive without coordination from outside the city.

published.md: dComms 的首席開發者表示，烏克蘭的砲擊經常切斷通往城市外部的光纖電纜，而連線通常在數小時或數天內恢復（2026 年 6 月對戰時烏克蘭部署的民用通訊專案 dComms 首席開發者所做的研究訪談）。*（依據 2026 年 6 月對 dComms 首席開發者與一名台灣民防演練參與者的研究訪談所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 本報告據此將單城孤立納入演練情境。這些演練針對公民社會與私部門的工程師設計，讓他們推演在缺乏城外協調時，在地服務如何維持運作。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. The Kherson case is a comparable event at city scale, but the conditions differ: Kherson was isolated by forced rerouting, and this scenario by a physical cut. The scenario requires the simultaneous cutting of every upstream long-haul fiber route of one city. The report found no published map of those routes for any Taiwanese city, so the number of separate routes that would have to be cut is unknown, and it will differ from city to city. The scenario is therefore a drill assumption, not a measured exposure.

published.md: **對台灣的適用程度：** 部分適用。赫爾松案例同樣是城市規模的孤立事件，但兩者條件不同：赫爾松是因強制重導路由而遭孤立，本情境則是源於實體線路遭切斷。本情境的前提是單一城市的所有上游長途光纖路徑同時遭切斷。本報告未找到任何台灣城市公開發布過這類路徑圖，因此需要切斷多少條獨立路徑目前未知，且各城市的情況也會有所不同。因此，本情境屬於演練假設，而非實測暴露風險。

en.md: **How to tell it from Partial-Access Partition.** *(Structural inference from the Partial-Access Partition and Single-City Isolation definitions)* The difference is the extent of the added failure. Both simulated scenarios sit under Island Partition, so in both the north–south trunks are cut. Partial-Access Partition changes the international side: one half keeps a small amount of global access. Single-City Isolation changes the domestic side: one municipality also loses its links to its own half, while domestic connectivity stays intact in every other part of each half.

published.md: **如何與「部分連外分割」區分。** *（依據「部分連外分割」與「單城孤立」定義所做的結構性推論）* 兩者的差異在於額外新增的失效範圍。這兩個模擬情境都隸屬於島內分割，因此南北向幹線在兩者中均已切斷。部分連外分割改變的是國際連網端：其中一半部仍保有少量的全球連網能力。單城孤立改變的則是國內連網端：單一直轄市／市同時失去與所屬半部的連線，而各半部其他地區的國內連線能力則維持完整。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would limit participants to the resources and communication paths physically inside one city and ask teams which locally hosted services, local coordination mechanisms and local human and organizational channels still work when network access outside the city is zero.

published.md: **演練備註。** 針對本情境的桌上推演，將參演人員限制僅能使用實體部位於單一城市內部的資源與通訊路徑，並詢問各團隊在城市外部網路存取完全歸零時，哪些在地託管的服務、在地協調機制以及在地的人與組織管道仍可運作。

en.md: #### Site-Level Blackout

published.md: #### Site-Level Blackout

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: a single rescue, shelter or critical-infrastructure site has no upstream connectivity at all, because its last-mile links are completely cut. The site becomes an isolated on-site network with no path to any external node on the domestic network or the global internet.

published.md: 島內分割下的一種模擬情境：單一救援、避難所或關鍵基礎設施站點因最後一哩鏈路完全切斷，而完全沒有任何上游連線能力。該站點變成一個孤立的現場網路，無法連通國內網路或全球網際網路上的任何外部節點。

en.md: **What happens.** The site's last-mile connections to all its upstream providers are cut at once. The cause is cut fiber, destroyed antenna installations, or loss of the power supply that sustains its radio links. The site's internal network keeps operating: devices reach each other, and locally hosted services and locally cached data stay accessible. No packet crosses the site boundary in either direction.

published.md: **事件經過。** 該站點至所有上游業者的最後一哩連線同時被切斷。原因可能包含光纖中斷、天線設施遭毀損，或是維持無線電鏈路的供電中斷。站點的內部網路仍可維持運作：裝置之間可互相連通，在地託管的服務與在地快取的資料依然可供存取。但雙向皆無任何封包能跨越站點邊界。

en.md: Every digital resource that the site depended on but did not host is unreachable. Examples are patient records, authorization systems, real-time operational data and software updates. Staff cannot reach emergency coordination systems hosted elsewhere, verify instructions from outside authorities, send status reports, or reach any live data source outside the site. The site's only working network resources are those that were present and operational on site before the last-mile link failed.

published.md: 該站點所依賴但未於在地託管的所有數位資源皆無法存取，例如病歷紀錄、授權系統、即時運作資料與軟體更新。工作人員無法存取託管於他處的緊急協調系統、無法確認外部機關的指示、無法傳送狀態報告，也無法存取站點外部的任何即時資料源。該站點唯一能運作的網路資源，僅有在最後一哩鏈路失效前已存在於現場且正常運作的資源。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition and the site-connectivity premise of the simulated scenario)* Site-Level Blackout follows from the definition of Island Partition: the partition and the global cutoff together cut every path out of each half. A site whose last-mile links are also cut then has no path to any external node, by construction.

published.md: **前例。** *（依據「島內分割」定義與模擬情境之站點連線前提所做的結構性推論）* 「站點全斷」推導自島內分割的定義：分割與全球斷線共同切斷了離開各半部的所有路徑。因此根據定義，最後一哩鏈路也被切斷的站點，自然無法連通至任何外部節點。

en.md: No primary source documents an event at exactly this scale. That scale is a single rescue or shelter site with its last-mile links completely cut while Island Partition is in effect at the same time. The precedent therefore rests on mechanism, not on an incident.

published.md: 尚無一手資料記載過完全屬於此等規模的事件——即在島內分割同時生效的狀況下，單一救援或避難所站點的最後一哩鏈路被完全切斷。因此，此前例係立基於機制推論，而非特定單一事件。

en.md: The war in Ukraine offers a partial illustration at a comparable scale. Individual Starlink terminals (satellite internet terminals) were the only connectivity path for some frontline sites. The loss or suppression of those terminals left those sites with no electronic communication path to any outside node ([Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)).

published.md: 烏克蘭戰爭提供了類似規模的局部佐證：個別 Starlink 終端機（衛星網際網路終端機）是部分前線站點唯一的連線路徑，當這些終端機喪失或遭到干擾抑制時，該站點便失去了前往任何外部節點的電子通訊路徑（[Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** directly. Any critical site in Taiwan that depends on a single last-mile connection path is susceptible to this pattern under the physical conditions that produce Island Partition.

published.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**直接適用。在引發島內分割的實體條件下，台灣任何依賴單一最後一哩連線路徑的關鍵站點，皆易受到此模式影響。

en.md: **How to tell it from Single-City Isolation.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Site-Level Blackout definitions)* The difference lies in BGP and routing. Single-City Isolation produces a routing event on the city's upstream AS paths, which route-collector data shows. Single-City Isolation also produces zero reachability from inside the city's address space, which probes show. Site-Level Blackout produces neither, because a site with no upstream connectivity takes no part in the routing table.
